assessment: This manuscript by Buscham and colleagues investigates the phenotype of mice lacking the myelin protein chemokine-like factor-like MARVEL-transmembrane domain containing protein 5 (CMTM5). Loss of CMTM5 has no detectable effect on myelin structure, but nevertheless leads to axonal degeneration. The data reveal previously undescribed functions for a myelin protein in preserving CNS axonal integrity. This article will be of particular interest to those in the field of myelin biology as well as to neuroscientists interested in mechanisms underlying axonal function and degeneration.
